findings.note: CBS lists George at 4.44 assists per game over 16 games in 2026-27, just under the 4.5 line. Earlier reports had him at 5.2 after 10 games and 4.8 after 12, which works out to roughly 13 assists in his last 4 games.

In his latest game, a 103-99 win over Toronto on Nov 19, George had 4 assists in 40 minutes. Washington plays him as a scorer behind Trae Young and Anthony Davis, and that lineup limits how much he handles the ball.
On Nov 3, George had 22 points and 5 assists in 37 minutes in a 103-94 win over this same Orlando team. I found no current injury report for him or for either team ahead of this game.
